steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Component 2 examines Global Film, requiring knowledge of set non-English language films and the ability to analyse and compare them. | Key Fact: Section A focuses on a non-English language European film, testing analysis of film language, representation and cultural context. | Key Fact: Section B focuses on a second non-English language film from outside Europe, testing similar skills with additional emphasis on global contexts. | Key Fact: Comparative analysis is central to Component 2: you must be able to discuss similarities and differences between your two set global films.
